blocks.text: Matsqui homes listed and sold, June to October 2026
Matsqui, October 2026. Detached houses: 5 listed at month end and 1 sold in October, a sales ratio of 20%. No condos and townhomes were listed or sold in Matsqui between June and October.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 3 sold over 5 months against an average of 4.8 listed, about 8.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 1 sold.

faq.q: Which public school is in Matsqui Village?
faq.a: Mathxwí Elementary School, at 33661 Elizabeth Ave, is the public school in the village; it was renamed from Matsqui Elementary, and the catchment school for a specific address is set through the SD34 School Locator. The recorded locator run for the school's own address confirms the full chain: Máthxwí Elementary → Clayburn Middle → Robert Bateman Secondary (SD34 School Locator, mybaragar.com, run 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Can a second dwelling be built on an A1 agricultural lot?
faq.a: The A1 zone allows one Accessory Farm Dwelling Unit per lot only in accordance with the ALR Use Regulation, B.C. Reg. 30/2019, or as approved by the Agricultural Land Commission, on a lot of at least 0.4 ha, to a maximum of 90 m² on lots of 40 ha or less and 186 m² on lots over 40 ha; one secondary suite per lot, to 100 m², is also permitted.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Matsqui?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 5 houses listed with 1 sold in the month in Matsqui. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Matsqui a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 20% on too few listings to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
